title: Recorded probe DATA
description: Read a chosen local raw DATA or capture archive for reconstruction. No upload or device access.

source.build: Built into the explicit recording host; no dynamic source evaluation.

behavior: Reads .bin in 64KiB chunks, legacy .odb-capture containers bounded to96MiB, or unbounded-length .odb-stream JSONL with bounded lines. Validates encoding, ordinals and totals. Rejects declared storage losses. Journal/display records never become device commands. File selection is runtime-only, excluded from compositions. The stream provides format candidates, not device identification or acoustic calibration.
